blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Frost on Thursday morning coated flowers grown at a farm tourism destination in Atok, Benguet, surprising its owner, who expected the cold to occur later in the Yuletide season amid a very strong El Niño. PJ Haight, proprietor of Haight’s Place in Barangay Paoay, shared photos of frost covering flowers at his farm, where he claimed temperatures dropped to 10 degrees Celsius at around 6 a.m., based on his own monitoring. “First strike. We thought we would not have frost because of El Niño, but here it is!” Haight said in a social media post. READ: Cool weather […]...
